selected_gaps.companion_rationale: heterogeneous_decomposition partitions each paired chunk into the shared-valid prefix, first simulator-certified violation segment, and post-violation remainder, yielding a temporal treatment mask O; self_supervised_signal_engineering consumes O together with generated-and-simulator-filtered geometry pairs to produce the boundary-local positive/negative score targets that make the decomposition a trainable method.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This is the most load-bearing construction gap because solving it prevents a geometry-specific failure from being miscredited to the whole action chunk, which is the bottleneck's direct cause of prefix corruption. heterogeneous_decomposition closes it by giving the physically different temporal regions tailored update rules, while explicitly avoiding the lineage's occupied artifacts of global collision costs, whole-chunk feasibility losses, safety projection, and unstructured contrastive negatives.

selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf shows that rejecting a geometry-invalid action mode can coexist with preserving all geometry-specific alternative-positive modes, especially feasible minority modes outside the dominant action cluster or nominal manifold (semanticscholar:8cb14cd9dafae88163a7685336a02ac6c41ed646; semanticscholar:4a71dc5d2b6b4ea2a6477ec4515d8294e3c75383) — stakes: a robot may become safer on one edited object while losing legitimate grasps, approaches, or reorientation strategies elsewhere, and apparent reliability gains may actually be mode collapse.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: Under a shared_evaluation thread, this sibling uses the same minimal geometry pairs and action-mode sets to test whether local invalid-mode suppression is purchased by collapsing feasible minority modes; removing it opens the decisive reviewer objection that apparent safety is just loss of diversity. controlled_diagnostic_design closes the gap by holding task semantics and positive-mode inventory fixed while separately measuring invalid-mode mass, each alternative mode's retained mass, and execution success.
